title: user.deactivated
description: Administrative access removal: the account's is_active flipped True -> False. REVERSIBLE and NOT a GDPR erasure — the account, its factors and all downstream records stay; the mirror event user.reactivated restores access. Consumers must suspend, never delete (the irreversible signal is user.deleted). Emitted once per real transition, whoever flipped the flag.

reason.description: Open vocabulary; absent when the flag was flipped without one (e.g. the admin checkbox).

actor_id.description: Staff user who performed it; absent for programmatic/unknown actors.
